text:
veronica_ng: heads-up 9GovCorp wants an air-gapped pilot with stricter controls than usual. Key asks: FIPS-140 HSM signing, signed SBOM bundles, chain-of-custody for physical media, and a documented upgrade cadence they can lock into their procurement (they prefer bi-annual but open to quarterly for higher fee). also asked per-site emergency SLA and sample indemnity language.

sam_choi: We can support HSM-backed signing (PKCS#11) and produce signed SBOMs (cyclonedx). Deltas possible but note: some quantized model shards won't delta efficiently -> may need full shard replacement. Agent minimum for offline delta apply: v2.7.0.

pauline_liu: Ops notes:
- delivery options: encrypted USB, signed ISO, or sealed SSD crate with tamper-evident manifest.
- apply command for demo: `redwood-offline-apply --manifest /media/usb/manifest.json --verify --sbom /media/usb/sbom.json`
- chain-of-custody: we can produce a custody log (who signed/packaged, timestamp, checksums) and a tamper-proof signature file.

eng-sales-bot: created POC ticket POC-20482 assigned sam_choi. link: https://app.redwood/POC-20482

security_omar: Pre-SOW items we need answered: acceptance of cyclonedx SBOM, root CA/HSM key exchange method, whether customer requires us to sign or will provide pre-signed manifests, retention/telemetry opt-out, and required audit evidence (SOC2 certs etc.). I can draft the questionnaire.

veronica_ng: Pricing guidance for sales: baseline secure-offline = $25k/yr/site (includes sealed packaging, HSM signing, one bi-annual delta). Quarterly cadence = +$8k/yr/site. Emergency SLA (24h hotfix) = +$9k/yr/site or $6k/event. Chain-of-custody add-on (physical notarization/logistics) = $3k/site initial. Travel billed T&M.

sam_choi: Demo manifest (trimmed) we9ll use on the kickoff call:
```
{"manifest_version":"1.2","site":"govcorp-east","bundles":["runtime-4.2.zst","models/gov-gptq"],"delta":true,"sbom":"sbom-cyclonedx.json","signature":"MEUCIQ..."}
```

pauline_liu: cadence recommendation: offer bi-annual as baseline for highly regulated customers (lower ops churn), quarterly as premium. hotfixes available as SLA. we require signed maintenance windows and acceptance sign-off before any offline apply.

security_omar: I9ll attach the questionnaire + a short HSM key-exchange playbook before the call. if they can provide their public key or HSM endpoint details we can demo end-to-end verification.

veronica_ng: plan: 45m kickoff Thurs 3pm ET. agenda: show custody & packaging photos, demo `redwood-offline-apply` verifying SBOM+signature on an offline VM, discuss cadence options/pricing, review questionnaire. can everyone make it?

sam_choi: I9ll prepare a sealed-demo bundle, custody log sample, and a short runbook for receiving sites. ETA: Wed EOD.

pauline_liu: I9ll draft the SOW clause for bi-annual vs quarterly cadence and the rollback acceptance steps.

security_omar: I9ll join and bring the questionnaire. If GovCorp can confirm SBOM acceptance format we9ll be golden.

veronica_ng: thanks team. if they send their root cert/key details ahead we can demo full end-to-end verify. :thumbsup:
